role: Military Police Investigator / Criminal Investigations Division (CID) Special Agent

primary_category.subcategory: A2.4 Information search, retrieval, gathering, and evaluation

evidence.quote: First thing was pulling the fuel reconciliation report and cross-referencing it against the duty roster to see who was on shift during the loss windows.
evidence.explanation: The agent retrieves and cross-references records from multiple sources to identify candidate personnel, a core information-gathering and verification act.

evidence.quote: I flagged it in the case file as unresolved and put in a request to pull the maintenance records before I leaned on it either way.
evidence.explanation: The agent actively seeks additional records to evaluate an ambiguous evidentiary anomaly before assigning weight.

evidence.quote: Phone records came back later and independently confirmed the call happened exactly when she said.
evidence.explanation: The agent evaluates witness testimony against independently retrieved corroborating records, a direct evidence-verification task.

evidence.quote: My options were to expand the investigation to properly vet that anomaly, or close out with what I had, centered on the original track, and let the Provost Marshal's Office pick it up from there.
evidence.explanation: The agent weighs alternative courses of action under deadline and resource constraints and organizes a plan for referral, reflecting non-routine problem resolution rather than a scripted next step.

evidence.quote: I could have finished the full overlap matrix first and let the data alone tell me who had the most matching dates before talking to anyone.
evidence.explanation: The agent articulates and compares alternative investigative sequences, indicating planning of resource allocation (limited time, single agent) toward the case objective.

evidence.quote: I think partly it's just experience—alibi statements from coworkers aren't always clean, people help each other out.
evidence.explanation: The agent applies a generalized mental model derived from prior case experience to interpret a new piece of evidence, going beyond simple retrieval to abstraction about behavior patterns.

evidence.quote: Once I did finish the matrix a couple days later, Doyle actually only matched two of the five theft dates.
evidence.explanation: The agent compares and quantifies date-overlap matches across personnel, a numerically comparative task even though it is simple counting rather than complex calculation.

evidence.quote: Battalion asked us to look into it because the losses were adding up and it was becoming a readiness issue.
evidence.explanation: The investigation is undertaken as a service to the battalion/command to resolve their operational problem, though this is a background motivator rather than an interpersonal service interaction and is therefore only weakly supported.

A1.2 Dexterity - no evidence of fine motor manipulation of tools or instruments
A1.3 Navigation - no described physical movement through the motor pool environment; site descriptions are referenced but not enacted in the narrative

A2.1 Uncodified visual or auditory information processing - no described direct sensory pattern recognition (e.g., interpreting camera footage or physical scene details); evidence handling is documentary
A3.2 Teaching, training, and coaching - no instructional interaction described
A3.3 Selling and influencing - the referral to the Provost Marshal's Office is a report, not a persuasive negotiation
A3.4 Managing and coordinating - the agent acts largely solo; no coordination of subordinates or multiple stakeholders' activities is described
A3.5 Caring - no welfare or health-oriented support described
ambiguities: A2.2 Literacy is plausibly implicated (reading logs, statements, writing a case file) but the interview never shows the agent composing or reading text directly; it is inferred from procedural context rather than directly observed, so it is treated as insufficiently evidenced rather than assigned.

evidence.quote: I decided to bring him in first.
evidence.explanation: The agent independently chooses investigative sequencing and priorities without describing a supervisor dictating the specific interview order, indicating meaningful discretion, though the overall case remains bounded by command's deadline and referral expectations.

evidence.quote: Command wanted this wrapped before an inspection that was maybe ten days out.
evidence.explanation: The investigation operates under an externally imposed deadline and is ultimately handed off to the Provost Marshal's Office, showing organizational oversight of outcomes and timing without moment-to-moment supervision of method.

evidence.quote: I was also the only agent assigned full-time, so I couldn't run parallel interview tracks the way I would've liked.
evidence.explanation: The agent explicitly works alone on the core investigative tasks; interactions with the NCOIC, dispatcher, and command are information exchanges or handoffs rather than joint task execution.

evidence.quote: a lot of this was going to come down to logs, statements, and timeline work rather than catching someone on video
evidence.explanation: Each evidentiary thread (fuel logs, key control, odometer, alibi, fuel-card anomaly) requires distinct handling rather than repeating an identical action.

evidence.quote: pulling the fuel reconciliation report and cross-referencing it against the duty roster
evidence.explanation: Cross-referencing reconciliation reports and duty rosters and building an overlap matrix suggests a recognized investigative procedure, though the interview does not describe an explicit checklist or protocol document.

evidence.quote: Turned out maintenance had done a documented test drive on the truck that accounted for the extra mileage.
evidence.explanation: Evidence interpretations repeatedly turn out differently than initially expected, indicating low predictability of what evidence will ultimately mean.

evidence.quote: The night-shift dispatcher gave a sworn statement that she'd been on the phone with Doyle the entire window during one of the suspected theft incidents.
evidence.explanation: The agent must adapt the investigative approach in response to an unanticipated, case-altering piece of testimony arriving mid-investigation.

tools.role_in_task: Reviewing and cross-referencing digital or written reconciliation reports, duty rosters, and key-control logs

evidence.quote: pulling the fuel reconciliation report and cross-referencing it against the duty roster
evidence.explanation: Reconciliation reports, duty rosters, and logs are treated as record systems the agent consults, consistent with routine record-keeping/office-type systems, though the interview does not specify whether these are digital databases or paper logs.

tools.role_in_task: Possible use of case-management or law-enforcement records systems to build the case file

evidence.quote: I flagged it in the case file as unresolved
evidence.explanation: Maintaining a formal case file suggests a specialized investigative record-keeping process, though the interview does not name or describe any specific software system, so confidence is limited.
